stem_book: If 0 < x < π and sin x + sin(2x) = cos x + cos(2x), which are true? One or more options may be correct. (a) tan(3x/2) = 1 (b) cos(3x/2) = sin(x/2) (c) x = π/3 is a solution (d) x = 2π/3 is a solution
key: a, c tan(3x/2) = 1; x = π/3 is a solution
reason: Printed key a,c; but x = π/3 gives LHS = √3, RHS = 0, so (c) is false — the solutions are x = π/6, 5π/6; only (a) holds.
